title: MMB 80% Mode-II quasi-static delamination benchmark

curve.scope: critical propagation path from Figures 20 and 21

graphical_extraction_uncertainty.basis: vector marker centers and vector plot axes in the source PDF

extraction.method: direct extraction of vector marker centers from the source PDF; no raster tracing
notes: The plot-origin construction point is omitted; the curve begins at the critical state.
The last displacement point near 50 mm crack extension has no in-range load point in Figure 21 and is omitted.
Mode-I fraction is the declared nominal complement of the 80% Mode-II case; the report notes that computed ratios vary slightly from the target.

claim_scope: external curve data for software-independent MMB propagation comparison; not a claim that AgentFEM has reproduced the curve
promotion_requirements: Run the source-declared geometry, material and fixture rather than fitting the digitized curve.
Compare the complete overlapping load and displacement curves under declared tolerances.
Report the computed global GI/GII partition independently of the nominal target fraction.
Provide mesh, increment, process-zone and energy-balance evidence.
